# New renderings and departures, iliad-051 (8.469–565)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| ὄβριμος Ἕκτωρ (8.473) | "mighty Hector" | "mighty Hector" | "stout", "violent", "overbearing"; ὄβριμος keeps "mighty" (the table's ὄβριμος Ἄρης); Hector's other epithets (φαίδιμος "glorious") stay apart |
| θέσφατόν ἐστι (8.477) | "it is god-declared" | "it is decreed" | "it is fated" (blurs μοῖρα); the Odyssey table's θέσφατόν ἐστι (4.561), reused unchanged |
| Ὑπερίονος Ἠελίοιο (8.480; Ὑπερίων a name of the sun-god, in apposition) | "Hyperion the Sun" | "Hyperion the Sun" | "the sun-god Hyperion", "Hyperion's sunlight"; Ἠέλιος keeps "the Sun" |
| αὐγῇς (8.480) | "the glare" | "the rays" | "the light" (reserved for φάος, 8.485); αὐγή "glare" as at 2.456 |
| κύντερον (σέο κύντερον ἄλλο, 8.483) | "more dog-like" | "more shameless" | "more brazen", "bitchier"; reused from the Odyssey table (κύντερον, 7.216) unchanged |
| τὸν δ’ οὔ τι προσέφη λευκώλενος Ἥρη (8.484, whole line; ὣς φάτο, … the reply-formula with the verb negated) | "So he spoke, and him not at all addressed white-armed Hera." | "So he spoke, and white-armed Hera said nothing to him." | "did not answer" (προσέφη is "addressed / said to", ἠμείβετο is "answered"); follows the table's προσέφη rows and λευκώλενος Ἥρη |
| τρίλλιστος (8.488; τρι- may be "three times" or "much") | "thrice-prayed-for" | "thrice prayed for" | "much longed for", "greatly desired" (each decides what τρι- means), "welcome" (kept for ἀσπασίη) |
| ἀσπασίη (νύξ, 8.488) | "welcome" | "welcome" | "gladly received", "longed for"; ἀσπάσιος "welcome" |
| Τρώων αὖτ’ ἀγορὴν ποιήσατο φαίδιμος Ἕκτωρ (8.489, whole-line assembly formula) | "Of the Trojans again an assembly made glorious Hector," | "Glorious Hector, in his turn, held an assembly of the Trojans," | "called a council"; ἀγορὴν ποιήσατο "held an assembly" as at 8.2 (iliad-046); αὖτ’ (= αὖτε) "again" in `l`, "in his turn" in `i` as in the table's τῶν αὖθ’ ἡγεμόνευ’ |
| ἐν καθαρῷ … νεκύων διεφαίνετο χῶρος (8.491) | "in a clean place, where indeed of the dead the ground showed through" | "to a clear place where the ground showed through, free of the dead" (+ note: νεκύων could also be read "among the dead") | "among the corpses" (decides the genitive the other way), "an open space" |
| τῷ ὅ γ’ ἐρεισάμενος ἔπεα Τρώεσσι μετηύδα (8.496, whole-line speech introduction) | "On this leaning, he spoke words among the Trojans:" | "Leaning on it, he spoke words among the Trojans:" | "addressed" (reserved for προσέφη), "spoke winged words" (ἔπεα πτερόεντα is another formula); μετηύδα "spoke among" as μετέειπε |
| ἀσπουδί (8.512; ἀ- + σπουδή) | "without effort" | "without any trouble" | "without a fight", "unhurt" (each decides the sense); formed from σπουδή "haste, effort" |
| βέλος … πέσσῃ (8.513) | "digest a shaft" | "nurse the hurt of a shaft" | "cook", "chew over", "carry a wound"; πέσσω "cook, digest" in `l`, the figure explained in the note; βέλος "shaft" as at 1.51 |
| στυγέῃσι (+ infinitive, 8.515) | "loathe" | "hate" | "dread", "shrink from"; kept as at 1.187 (iliad-002) |
| θεοδμήτων (πύργων, 8.519) | "god-built" | "built by the gods" (towers) | "divinely built", "god-made"; θεός + δέμω "build", as in the table's δέμω "build" |
| πρωθήβας · πολιοκροτάφους (8.518) | "in first youth" · "grey-templed" | "in early youth" · "grey-templed" | "beardless", "teenage" · "white-haired" (loses κρόταφος "temple") |
| θηλύτεραι γυναῖκες (8.520) | "the female women" | "the women" | "womenfolk", "the weaker sex"; follows the Odyssey table's θηλύτεραι θεαί "the female goddesses" / "the goddesses" |
| φυλακὴ … ἔμπεδος (8.521) | "firm watch" | "firm watch" | "steady", "steadfast", "sound" (reserved for other words); follows the table's ἔμπεδοι φρένες "wits firm" |
| ὑγιὴς μῦθος (8.524) | "the speech … sound" | "the word … sound" | "healthy", "wholesome", "safe"; ὑγιής "sound" (literally "healthy"), μῦθος "word" |
| κηρεσσιφορήτους (κύνας, 8.527; κῆρες + φορέω) | "borne by death-spirits" | "borne by the spirits of death" | "carried by fates", "fate-borne", "plague-carrying"; κήρ "death-spirit" as in the table's κῆρες θανάτοιο |
| ὑπηοῖοι (8.530) | "at dawn" | "at dawn" | "at daybreak", "before dawn" (ὑπό does not mean "before"); ἠώς "dawn" |
| ἀρετή (8.535) | "excellence" | "excellence" | "valour", "prowess"; the Odyssey table's ἀρετή (8.237) unchanged |
| ἑταῖροι · οὐτηθείς (8.537) | "companions" · "wounded" | "companions" · "wounded" | "comrades" (the table keeps ἑταῖρος "companion"), "killed", "pierced" (οὐτάω "wound with a thrust", as in the published οὔτασε "wounded") |
| εἰ γὰρ ἐγὼν ὣς εἴην ἀθάνατος καὶ ἀγήρως ἤματα πάντα, τιοίμην δ’ ὡς τίετ’ Ἀθηναίη καὶ Ἀπόλλων (8.538–540) | "For if only I thus were immortal and ageless all my days, and were honoured as Athena and Apollo are honoured" | "If only I were as surely immortal and ageless for all my days, and honoured as Athena and Apollo are honoured" | "deathless" (reserved for ἀθάνατος in the Odyssey, kept apart from ἄμβροτος), "I wish I were"; ἀγήρως "ageless" as at 2.447; ἤματα πάντα "all my days" |
| ὣς Ἕκτωρ ἀγόρευ’, ἐπὶ δὲ Τρῶες κελάδησαν (8.542, whole-line speech closing formula) | "So Hector declared, and upon it the Trojans shouted." | "So Hector spoke, and the Trojans shouted in response." | "cheered", "applauded" (decides the tone), "murmured"; ἀγορεύω "declare" in `l` and "spoke" in `i` as in the table's ὣς ἔφατ’ rows |
| ἡδεῖαν · δατέοντο · ἀπήχθετο (8.550–551, bracketed lines) | "sweet" · "did … partake" · "was hateful" | "sweet" · "took … share" · "was hateful" | "pleasant", "fragrant" · "divided", "accepted" · "had become hateful", "had grown hateful" (the table and iliad-020, -037 give ἀπήχθετο "was hateful"); δατέομαι "share" |
| πτολέμοιο γεφύρας (8.553) | "the bridges of war" | "the bridges of war" | "the ridges of war", "the fighting-ground"; kept as in iliad-025 (4.371) |
| ἀριπρεπέα (ἄστρα … φαίνετ’ ἀριπρεπέα, 8.556) | "outstanding" | "outstanding" | "conspicuous" (reserved for ἀριδείκετος), "brilliant", "glorious"; ἀριπρεπής "outstanding" as in the table's ἐκπρεπής row |
| νήνεμος αἰθήρ (8.556) | "windless … upper air" | "windless … upper air" | "windless sky", "still heavens" (οὐρανός is "heaven"); αἰθήρ "upper air" as in the table's row for 2.412 |
| ὑπερράγη … ἄσπετος αἰθήρ (8.558) | "is torn open the boundless upper air" | "the boundless upper air bursts open" | "the sky splits", "the immense air"; ἄσπετος "boundless" as in iliad-011, ῥήγνυμι "break" |
| γέγηθε … φρένα ποιμήν (8.559) | "rejoices in his mind" | "is glad in his mind" | "his heart rejoices", "is happy at heart" (φρένα is "mind"); γήθω "rejoice" |
| σέλας (8.509, 8.563) | "the gleam" · "the gleam" | "the gleam" · "the gleam" | "the blaze", "the glare" (αὐγή is "glare"), "the flash" (the table's σέλας of lightning, 8.75); here of firelight, a gleam |
| μίμνον (8.565) | "awaited" | "waited for" | "stayed for", "remained for"; μίμνω = μένω "wait for" |
